channel.title: ANGPTL4 & Adipose RNA Update
channel.description: Weekly digest of ANGPTL4 biology/therapeutics and adipose-targeted RNA delivery (siRNA, ASO, LNP, GalNAc).
channel.itunes:author: Ethan Weiss

item.title: ANGPTL4 & Adipose RNA Update — Monday June 29, 2026
item.description: A thin but focused week — ANGPTL4 surfaces in a gut-microbiome/adipose crosstalk review and in a mechanistic study linking YAP condensates to proangiogenic ANGPTL4 expression, while an adipocyte cell-death study employs adipocyte-specific siRNA to implicate caspase-8 in adipogenesis.
item.itunes:title: ANGPTL4 & Adipose RNA Update — Monday June 29, 2026

item.title: ANGPTL4 & Adipose RNA Update — Monday June 22, 2026
item.description: A thin week for direct ANGPTL4 therapeutics, but a standout paper demonstrates that circular RNA delivered via lipid nanoparticles can drive sustained GDF15-mediated fat burning in obese mice — a proof-of-concept for RNA-LNP therapies targeting adipose metabolism.
item.itunes:title: ANGPTL4 & Adipose RNA Update — Monday June 22, 2026

item.title: ANGPTL4 & Adipose RNA Update — Monday June 15, 2026
item.description: A thin week on the primary beat — two correspondence letters debate ANGPTL4 as a stroke biomarker, while two independent studies use siRNA knockdown in human and porcine adipose-derived stem cells to probe fat biology, reinforcing the utility of RNA tools in adipose tissue.
item.itunes:title: ANGPTL4 & Adipose RNA Update — Monday June 15, 2026

item.title: ANGPTL4 & Adipose RNA Update — Monday June 8, 2026
item.description: ANGPTL4 emerges prominently as a therapeutic target in a landmark Circulation Research review of triglyceride-rich lipoprotein metabolism and cardiovascular risk in diabetes, while new work in adipocyte biology highlights PPARγ-mediated transcriptional programs and antiadipogenic peptide mechanisms with direct ANGPTL4 relevance.
item.itunes:title: ANGPTL4 & Adipose RNA Update — Monday June 8, 2026

item.title: ANGPTL4 & Adipose RNA Update — Monday June 1, 2026
item.description: Three new papers this week illuminate ANGPTL4's role in tumor microenvironments, adipose-driven metabolic dysfunction in heart failure, and as an early-life obesity biomarker; no new adipose RNA delivery papers appeared in the lookback window.
item.itunes:title: ANGPTL4 & Adipose RNA Update — Monday June 1, 2026

item.title: ANGPTL4 & Adipose RNA Update — Monday May 25, 2026
item.description: Intestinal ANGPTL4 emerges as a diet-and-microbiome integrator driving gut barrier dysfunction in early fatty liver disease, while new ionizable-lipid LNP platforms continue to expand the toolkit for tissue-selective RNA delivery beyond the liver.
item.itunes:title: ANGPTL4 & Adipose RNA Update — Monday May 25, 2026

item.title: ANGPTL4 & Adipose RNA Update — Monday May 18, 2026
item.description: This week's literature shows ANGPTL4 emerging as a multi-context tumor suppressor in head and neck cancer and a ferroptosis regulator in lung injury, while Mendelian randomization studies strengthen its causal standing in metabolic-cardiovascular disease; LNP delivery science advances on bone-marrow and lung-tumor fronts but adipose-selective RNA targeting remains an active gap.
item.itunes:title: ANGPTL4 & Adipose RNA Update — Monday May 18, 2026

item.title: ANGPTL4 & Adipose RNA Update — Monday May 11, 2026
item.description: A large LURIC cohort analysis ties CD-ANGPTL4 to heart failure incidence and mortality, an OPSCC study reframes ANGPTL4 as a tumor suppressor in head-and-neck cancer, and a Cardiovascular Diabetology review flags ANGPTL4 inhibition as a candidate combination therapy for diabetic vascular complications. Patent search is offline this week.
item.itunes:title: ANGPTL4 & Adipose RNA Update — Monday May 11, 2026

item.title: ANGPTL4 & Adipose RNA Update — Wednesday May 6, 2026
item.description: ANGPTL4 continues to generate broad clinical interest this week, with new mechanistic data in diabetic retinopathy, acute lung injury, and hepatocellular carcinoma; no new adipose-targeted RNA delivery papers appeared in the 7-day window.
item.itunes:title: ANGPTL4 & Adipose RNA Update — Wednesday May 6, 2026

item.title: ANGPTL4 & Adipose RNA Update — Monday May 4, 2026
item.description: Six new studies reinforce ANGPTL4 as a multi-tissue regulator with relevance to lipid metabolism, diabetic complications, and emerging therapeutic strategies; no adipose-targeted RNA delivery papers appeared in the past 7 days.
item.itunes:title: ANGPTL4 & Adipose RNA Update — Monday May 4, 2026

item.title: ANGPTL4 & Adipose RNA Update — Wednesday April 29, 2026
item.description: ANGPTL4 expanded its footprint in diabetic complications this week — strong mechanistic data implicating it in proliferative diabetic retinopathy and a new review on its role in diabetic nephropathy — alongside cancer angiogenesis, lung-injury cytoprotection, and head-and-neck SCC prognosis. No new adipose-targeted RNA delivery papers (siRNA/ASO/LNP/GalNAc) appeared in the lookback window.
item.itunes:title: ANGPTL4 & Adipose RNA Update — Wednesday April 29, 2026
